# PenseeWeb

> India's premier AI-powered visual study and syllabus-aligned mindmapping platform.

PenseeWeb transforms dense textbooks, 50-page notes, lecture recordings, and regional language audio into interactive, high-retention visual mindmaps. Engineered specifically for competitive Indian examinations (JEE, NEET, UPSC, CA Final, Class 10/12 Boards), PenseeWeb provides predictive exam analytics with its patent-pending "Panic Button™" to highlight high-probability exam nodes for last-minute mastery.

## Core Products & Features
- [PenseeWeb AI App](https://penseeweb.in/): Interactive SaaS application for generating mindmaps from PDFs, documents, notes, and audio.
- [Product Overview](https://penseeweb.in/product-page): Complete feature breakdown including Thematic Intelligence Engine, Exam Frequency Heatmaps, and Neuro-Precision learning modes.
- [About PenseeWeb](https://penseeweb.in/about): Origins, educational philosophy, and mission to eliminate rote learning panic.
- [Careers](https://penseeweb.in/careers): Roles in engineering, AI pedagogy, and visual design.
- [News & Resources Hub](https://penseeweb.in/resources): Company news, educational research, and case studies.

## Pricing Structure (in INR)
- **Freemium Tier:** 3 free mindmaps upon sign-up (WhatsApp OTP), plus 2 free maps/month.
- **Pay-Per-Map:** ₹9–₹15 per map from user notes (up to 6 pages/25 mins); ₹15–₹30 for AI-generated notes.
- **Subscriptions:**
  - Weekly: ₹100 (10 maps)
  - Monthly Pro: ₹350 (50 maps, unlimited 3D views, PYQ battle simulations)
  - Annual: ₹2,800 (600 maps, 20% discount)
